precision.reason: With 4096 families the 95% half-width of a proportion is at most 0.98/sqrt(4096)=0.015 (about 0.007 near 0.05), enough to separate nominal 0.05 error from the much larger uncorrected FWER at m=200 and 2000; FDR and power half-widths are reported per stratum and the claims are limited to what they resolve.
